name: book-card
title: Book card
description: A book in a catalogue: a 2:3 cover with a typographic fallback, title, authors, rating, formats and whether it is available, reserved or out on loan.
docs: title is the one link of the card (href); authors are written as a list in the reader's language ('Tom Calder and Ana Ruiz'). cover is an address or { src, alt }, kept in a 2:3 box from the first paint; a typographic tile with the title and the first author sits under it, so it also stands in while the picture loads, when there is none and when it fails. rating and ratingCount draw the stars to the exact average and read as a sentence. formats (print, ebook, audio) are word chips. availability is available, reserved or out, written in words with a glyph; for out, dueDate ('2026-11-12' is the day it says in any time zone, any other moment is written in timeZone) adds 'Due back 12 Nov'. price is a number in the currency and locale you name, whole amounts losing their cents, or your own words ('Free to borrow'). orientation is horizontal (the cover beside the text, for lists) or vertical (the cover on a quiet shelf above it, for grids). The card keeps no state and renders on the server; only the cover is a small client component, which takes itself away when the picture fails to load, so the jacket shows. labels carries every word.
